newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh sells ship damaged by cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh sells ship damaged by cyclone.

text.p: State-owned Bangladesh Shipping Corporation (BSC) has sold its ship Banglar Sampad, scrapped after it was damaged by last month's cyclone, BSC officials said on Tuesday.
Built in India in 1970, the 12,883 dwt freighter was sold to a local ship-breaking company for 35 million taka ($810,000) at an auction held last week, they said.
Ship scrap is used in re-rolling mills for making rods for construction purposes.
The BSC now has 16 sea-going ships.
The cyclone on May 19 killed more than 120 people and left over a million homeless in coastal areas of Bangladesh.
